deliverable: Go-Explore solver adapter: configs/kid_icarus.yaml `solve:` block + runs/kid_icarus/kid_icarus_bootstrap archive.
method: All observables (re)discovered LIVE from THIS core's Stage-1 start state via our own scripted + jumpy restore-explore rollouts only (scripts/ki_*.py). Full 2KB RAM differential + noop-stability + gameplay-locked-wrap + SATURATION tests. Real climb confirmed by rendered frames (NESEnvironment.get_frame). No external RAM maps / disassembly.
game_type: VERTICAL climber: the screen scrolls UP only and falling off the bottom kills => forward progress = HEIGHT (altitude).

step1_gameplay_verified.test: hold RIGHT (w0) vs hold LEFT (w1) 40 frames from the start state; player_x 0x0026 divergence
step1_gameplay_verified.verdict: IN-GAMEPLAY (divergence 119 >> 25): inputs move RAM, not the input-ignoring title/attract demo. (Left worker's 0x0026 wrapped 88->207 moving off the start ledge; right worker held against geometry — both prove live control.)

chosen_progress.meaning: 16-bit ALTITUDE odometer. 0x04D1 = screen counter (+1 per screen climbed); 0x0750 = fine within-screen altitude (rises with climb).
chosen_progress.why_the_config_said_none_exists: The profile description claimed vertical progress had 'no clean RAM byte (Pit's Y lives in OAM; blind play never scrolled the camera to expose a monotonic altitude counter)'. TRUE for blind/random play — but Go-Explore's restore-explore climbed ~8-10 screens and EXPOSED the accumulator. It was a hard-exploration blind spot, not a missing byte.

screen_counter_0x04D1.rate: +1 per screen (start 1 -> 9 over ~8 rendered screens of climb)
screen_counter_0x04D1.complement_check: 0x001A == 256 - 0x04D1 EXACTLY (255/1 at start, 247/9 deep) — the decreasing camera-Y complement; cross-confirms the screen count.
screen_counter_0x04D1.not_a_clock: FLAT under 200 noop steps (screens don't advance while standing) => not a free-running/fixed-cadence frame counter (the MM2-bootstrap trap).
screen_counter_0x04D1.saturation_test: PASSED. Keeps incrementing across every screen climbed; reached 9 in the depth-max discovery beam (scripts/ki_maxheight.py) with no cap. NOT a camera-clamp byte (the Kirby trap).

fine_altitude_0x0750.within_screen_1_range: 0 .. ~107 (rises with climb); reached 248 at screen 6 under the solver
fine_altitude_0x0750.mirror_complement: 0x0074 is its inverse (238 -> 131 as climbing, span ~107/screen) — same fine altitude, opposite sign.
fine_altitude_0x0750.direction: INCREASES with climb (0x0074 decreases), so 0x0750 is the correct progress low byte for GenericGame (ram[lo] | ram[hi]<<8, no negation available).

odometer_monotonicity.test: 1788 CONTINUOUS alive climb segments (restore-explore, recorded only between restores); mono_nondecreasing fraction of (0x04D1*256 + 0x0750)
odometer_monotonicity.guaranteed_across_seams: progress can drop at most 255 (0x0750 is a byte) at a +256 screen stride, so screen*256+fine is monotone-nondecreasing across screen boundaries by construction.
odometer_monotonicity.honesty_note: 0x0750 and 0x04D1 are NOT frame-locked (0x0750 does not wrap 255->0 exactly at each screen boundary — a screen is ~108-256 fine units, not exactly 256). This is a (screen<<8 | fine) COMPOSITE that is empirically monotone in continuous play (mono 1.000), not a textbook lockstep 16-bit pair. A small backward seam artifact of <=255 can occur at a boundary frame; Go-Explore domination absorbs it (verified: the solver climbed cleanly to 2040).

ground_truth_render_confirmation.start_frame: runs/kid_icarus/_frame_start.png (bottom Underworld, Pit in doorway, score 0, 0x04D1=1)
ground_truth_render_confirmation.deep_frame: runs/kid_icarus/_frame_deep.png (visibly higher/different Underworld region, Pit mid-climb, score 700, 0x04D1=9)
ground_truth_render_confirmation.verdict: REAL climb: the deep state is a different, higher part of the level (score 0->700), not a same-screen artifact.

rejected.0x0074 / 0x00FD (mirror pair): fine altitude but DECREASES with climb; GenericGame cannot negate, so used as the y/vertical cross-reference, not progress low byte.
rejected.0x001A: screen counter but DECREASES (256 - 0x04D1); can't be a rising progress high byte.
rejected.0x0016 / 0x0017 / 0x00F8: jump/velocity STATE flags (values cycle 0/1/8/65/128/129) — not a smooth position; rejected as y.
rejected.high-range noisy bytes (0x073A/0x073E/0x: enemy/RNG/render churn; fail the within-segment monotone-ratchet test (mono << 1).
rejected.0x0350/0x0351/0x0239: reach a fixed value quickly then flatten (state flags), not a climb accumulator.

y.role: cell secondary-diversity dimension = player_x (horizontal). VERIFIED-LIVE (88 idle -> 214 RIGHT per config ram_mapping). Chosen over a vertical byte because for a camera-following climber Pit's screen-Y stays ~centered (poor diversity) while altitude is already the progress axis; horizontal position (which platform column) is the useful extra cell axis. CAVEAT: observatory's up/down dY outcome then reads horizontal response — still surfaces mode bytes, noted.

area.role: stage self-label (stage_index, VERIFIED-STABLE at 0; splits cells per stage on a real clear)

level_key.role: coverage baseline — 0x0130's 0->1 stage-advance was never triggered under bootstrap play (Stage 1-1 never cleared). It IS the true clear (held 0 across 300k+ frames AND on death => no false positives); wire level_key: [0x0130] once a solve trajectory clears the stage.

lives.role: MONOTONE NO-OP SENTINEL. Kid Icarus has NO life count; the only clean death signal is HP->0. 0x0130 only ever increases (stage clear), so lives<start_lives never false-fires, and real death is delegated to player_state below. TRAP AVOIDED: lives=0x00A6 would flag every restored deep cell (HP<7) instantly-dead and collapse the search to HP=7 states.

player_state.role: HP (health). 7 at spawn; bleeds to 0 on death.

death_states.role: HP == 0 => death (covers BOTH fall-off-the-bottom AND bleed-out).

step3_death_discovery.test: 37 real deaths (HP->0) collected under a fall-prone policy; alive-vs-death byte differential (scripts/ki_death.py)
step3_death_discovery.result: 0x00A6 (HP) is the ONLY clean death signal: constant 7 alive, 0 on death, disjoint. No separate death/dying flag exists (predeath HP mean 1 => catches both instant fall-deaths and gradual bleed-out).

step4_smoke.pool: Pool(3 workers) loaded the start state and stepped

step5_solve_vs_random.OUT_TRAVELS_RANDOM: YES, decisively. Go-Explore reached progress 2040 (screen 7) vs random's 289 (screen 1). A Stage-1 vertical climb is exactly the hard-exploration regime random play stalls in; restore-explore is what exposes the altitude accumulator at all.
